name: @psyb0t/keepassbox
summary: Connect to a self-hosted KeePassBox over MCP.
description: Manage the KeePass vaults and entries authorized by the configured token. https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-keepassbox

KEEPASSBOX_URL.description: Base URL of the trusted KeePassBox instance.

KEEPASSBOX_TOKEN.description: Scoped bearer token sent to that instance.

url.description: Legacy setting. Use KEEPASSBOX_URL in the gateway environment.

token.description: Legacy setting. Use KEEPASSBOX_TOKEN in the gateway environment.
